full_page.content:
1933, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO.5.
Page 151 Cont.
Dec. 14th, 1935 Enrolled again To-day; was here in person for some bleeding, suffering again fearful diabetis - wonders why she did not die two yrs. ago. 1937 died several yrs later. Fr. Sol.
Page 152
Oct. 13 John L. Gault - 45 - Methodist - phlebitis, neuritis, and arthri- tis - suffers terribly at night, heart trouble - for 3 yrs. on crutches & in wheel chair since last March. Enrolled Today +
14 th Mrs. Helen Hoppe - 77 - Lutheran - Complication - heart, kidney, stomach, was extremely restless, meaning almost continually ... Catholic neighbor called up to enroll in S. Mass A. at about same time old lady went to sleep. This was Oct. 6th - last week ... now up & O.K.
Mr. & Mrs. C. Morrissette - 52 - sleeping - & children - youngest 6 yrs.
Walter Duda - 24 - 5 yrs. in Jackson on 10 - 20 yrs .....
17th Mr. R. Messner - 47 - Ruptured - fears operation - praying her hus- band embrace the true faith.
Elix. Liggins - 29 - Neuritis, etc. ...
17 Eliz. Dwyer - 40 - threatening groth on breasts and back - fears to see doctor - trouble continuing since May.
Stanley N. Cockburn - 8 - pneumonia .... Enrolled To-night.
Page 153 18th
Oct. 17 Arthur Alders - 39 - Episcopelian - abcess on liver - very low - Enrolled perpetually at 10 P.M., Oct. 17th % non-catholic Wife - 7 P.M. wife phones to thank: "Mr. A. much better.". Oct. 18 Wife phones at 7 p.m. to say husband decidedly improved ... "husband continues improving" ... Nov. 8 "Husb. expected home soon" Nov. 22 Home and well. Jan. 18 comes to monastery on
Louis J. Lang - lost to family for three yrs. prayed for & enrol- led - now home & O.K.
Rose Stromb - non c. - about 50 - feared to be dying of heart fail- ure, has son & daughter.
Joseph Famulara - 30 - T.B. in Albuquerque - given only a few days to live - enrolled 1.00
